title: CITERIFT Stage 04 claim evidence set, version 1
description: The evidence of one claim (owner decision D-047): a content-addressed blob named by claim_recorded.evidence_set. Every list is sorted ascending and holds unique evidence ids; nothing is truncated. The order and the agreement with the claim (list counts, alternative count, upstream reason evidence) are checked by Investigation Memory on append and on open; every id must name evidence committed earlier (M-4, M-7). A missing or corrupt set is corruption, never an empty set.

alternatives.description: List i supports the claim's alternative i.
